name: v214_fcf_comp_profit_compact
hypothesis: Post-v213 local composite scan found the cleanest remaining low-corr blend around LLpGdlrm + A1wrAX3E + 9qwWXNW9. This compact proxy combines FCF yield/capex restraint with competitor-return absorption and operating profitability, without current-accrual, sales-delivery, or long-option terms from 58w2kxAz.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(free_cash_flow_reported_value / equity, 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_capex_maxguidance / cap, 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), industry) + 0.140 * rank(-(close / open - 1)), -1)
notes: Lightweight proxy for the best post-v213 composite. Strict-check against 9qwWXNW9, omKJ5nLl, A1wrAX3E, 58w2kxAz, and omKoaQMl.

name: v214_fcf_comp_non_eps_residual
hypothesis: FCF/capex guidance often collides with EPS/value capacity. This variant explicitly subtracts a small EPS value sleeve while keeping competitor-return and operating-profit confirmation, testing whether the FCF edge can avoid the EPS/contract/value blockers.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(free_cash_flow_reported_value / equity, 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_capex_maxguidance / cap, 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) - 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Tests whether subtracting EPS value lowers corr to omKJ5nLl / akd1nQMW / 78wvg3wO without killing FCF strength.

name: v214_fcf_comp_lowcorr_regime
hypothesis: The FCF + competitor blend may be more independent when SPY correlation is falling. This uses a regime gate to reduce overlap with ordinary reversal/value actives while preserving FCF/capex and competitor/earnings signals.
expression: trade_when(correlation_last_60_days_spy < correlation_last_360_days_spy, 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(free_cash_flow_reported_value / equity, 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_capex_maxguidance / cap, 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Regime-gated version; reject if it maps back to E5w8oepG / A1wrAX3E / 9qwWXNW9.

name: v214_fcf_comp_no_reversal_lowrisk
hypothesis: If the compact blend's low-corr estimate depends too much on open-close reversal, this no-reversal version uses low beta/correlation and competitor authority instead. It should reveal whether the parent has strength without the common reversal sleeve.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(free_cash_flow_reported_value / equity, 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_capex_maxguidance / cap, 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: No open-close or current-accrual/sales/long-option terms. Submit only if it clears metrics and true daily-PnL corr.
